test_mesh_rasterizer_single: test MeshRasterizer by rasterizing a single icosphere mesh and comparing output to a reference binary mask
test_mesh_rasterizer_batch: test MeshRasterizer with a batch of 10 extended meshes and verify each matches the reference image
test_mesh_rasterizer_kwargs: test MeshRasterizer by passing R and T kwargs at call time to change the view transform zoom
test_mesh_rasterizer_no_cameras: test MeshRasterizer initialization without cameras and verify it raises a ValueError when called without them
test_point_rasterizer: test PointsRasterizer by rasterizing a single pointcloud and a batch of 10 pointclouds against a reference mask
